answer: Admission runs like customs at a tundra crossing: every new identity presents a signed hardware manifest, and the officer on duty is a vertex committee redrawn each epoch by chained randomness, so no farm knows which panel audits its paperwork. Two members must independently rerun the newest proof of work before the seal sets. A clone caught at the border voids its entire haven of sponsor-backed entries, and because sponsors post bond per entry, a haven of fakes is a haven of forfeits. Honest agents cross once and never think about it again.
